messages:
maria_cs: Customer (AcmeCorp) pinged — their tenant view on latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines after today's deployment. Org-level still shows them. Customer says this broke their SLO alerting. Can SRE/telemetry take a look?

alex_sre: on it. which deploy was it? any customer repro steps?

maria_cs: they sent screenshots — tenant view panels only show mean/median. They ran the same query in Data Explorer and no series tagged with quantile=p95.

dev-deploy-bot: metrics-collector/v2 deployed to prod at 2026-03-17T12:34:20Z by infra-cd (pipeline #4187) :white_check_mark:

ingrid_telemetry: deploying collector v2 included label normalization change (renamed "quantile" -> "pctl") to align with new exporter. Dashboard panels filter on quantile=* currently. possible label mismatch. i'll dig into series.

sam_engineer: i pulled raw timeseries for org=acmecorp/tenant=acme-123 via promql in staging — before deploy there are series like latency_ms{quantile="p95"}, after deploy those series show up as latency_ms{pctl="95"}. so queries using quantile= are returning no results.

alex_sre: that matches. dashboard and alert rules still use quantile label at tenant-level. org-level dashboard uses an aggregate query (histogram_quantile) so it still shows tails. tenant panels were filtering on label equality.

maria_cs: sent interim update to customer — asked if they can tolerate org-level view while we patch. they prefer faster turnaround.

jason_pm: opened support ticket #4529 and linked to internal incident. tagging priority-high for customer SLO impact.

ingrid_telemetry: quick mitigation: add label aliasing in metrics-translation layer to map pctl->quantile for previous dashboards. rolling patch to prod now.

alex_sre: pushed hotfix that aliases labels for existing time series queries and updated tenant dashboard JSON to accept either label. patch ID: infra/telemetry#287. rolling canary to 3 hosts.

dev-deploy-bot: infra/telemetry#287 rollout to canary (hostset telemetry-canary) started at 2026-03-17T12:56:10Z

sam_engineer: can reproduce on staging with alias in place — queries now return latency_ms{quantile="p95"} again (backfilled view overlay shows p95/p99 lines).

maria_cs: customer confirmed via screenshot — p95/p99 lines reappeared in tenant view. thanked support.

ingrid_telemetry: root cause summary: collector v2 changed exporter label from "quantile" to "pctl". dashboards and alert rules that explicitly matched quantile= were not backward-compatible. mitigation: label aliasing + dashboard queries updated to accept both labels. follow-up: add integration test to catch label renames and add release note for metrics contract change.

alex_sre: closing internal incident after monitoring 30m — no regressions seen. will create follow-up RFC for metrics label stability.

maria_cs: marked customer ticket resolved. closing thread. :tada:
